_doc: Things found while farming (scripts/systems/finds_system.gd). A family is a set of collectable kinds found by one kind of farm work. trigger.on is the work that rolls it (harvest); chance is per roll, raised by the crop's mastery stars (mastery_luck per star); pity guarantees one after that many dry rolls. Each kind has a weight (how often among its family) and a rarity. tiers are the counts owned at which the family's home grows a level; reward is paid once when every kind has been found.
